<instruction>
 Your instructions are the following:
1. Identify the entity types described by the table.
2. Choose one main entity type that the table primarily describes.
3. Identify any other entity types that relate to the main entity.
4. For the main entity and each related entity, list the attributes (columns) that belong to it.

grouping_phase.system: You are a data engineer tasked to design an integrated schema that will be used to represent all data from a set of source tables.
grouping_phase.human:

Your task is to group (cluster) the tables that describe the same entity type, so that all tables that describe the same or semantically similar entity types are put into the same group. Name each group according to the entity type of the grouped tables. If a hierarchy can be observed between the found groups, combine the tables that are connected through this hierarchy and name the overall group after the highest entity type in the hierarchy.

final_integration_phase.human:

When introducing identifiers, if there is a relationship between two table schemas (or more) use the identifiers as foreign keys and replace the old attributes.
